events.detail_en: Why: Hand-written JSON-LD inside HTML templates gets HTML-escaped and breaks on quotes; building the graph as template maps keeps escaping correct by construction. Rejected: hand-written JSON-LD strings; a client-side script injecting JSON-LD. Evidence: templates/partials/structured-data.html; scripts/validate-html.py parses every JSON-LD block.
events.title_en: Structured data is built as Tera data and serialised with json_encode

events.detail_en: Why: A shared link preview is often the only part of the work a reader sees; hreflang alternates in the sitemap and og:locale:alternate keep each edition discoverable in its own language. Rejected: one English preview card for all pages; hreflang only in HTML. Evidence: templates/sitemap.xml; tests/site.spec.js 'link previews are localized and reachable'.
events.title_en: Link previews are localized per language, and the sitemap lists every language edition

events.detail_en: Why: User preference is pytest for Python; a venv keeps the global interpreter untouched and CI reproducible. Rejected: stdlib unittest; installing pytest globally. Evidence: requirements-dev.txt pins pytest 9.1.1.
events.title_en: Python validators are tested with pytest in a project venv

events.title_en: Evidence is tracked as a dated ledger: data/sources.toml appraises every registry reference (design, level A–E), data/claims.toml records each public claim (type, level, confidence, sources, where used, last_reviewed, review_due), and validators fail the build on stale or inconsistent entries

findings.detail_cs: První úloha si nárokovala 20 cest, ale ne kořenové soubory přesunuté do artwork/ a static/. Handover zaznamenává, že majordomus watch nahlásil odchylku; úloha byla ukončena jako partial a restartována před prvním pushem.
findings.detail_en: The first task claimed 20 paths but not the root files that were moved into artwork/ and static/. The handover records that majordomus watch reported the drift; the task was finished as partial and restarted before the first push.
findings.title_cs: Odchylka od rozsahu po přesunu souborů; úloha restartována
findings.title_en: Scope drift after files were moved; task restarted

findings.detail_cs: Restartovaná úloha zadala rozsah jako ".", což Majordomus nečte jako celý repozitář, a majordomus check proto nahlásil každý změněný soubor jako mimo rozsah. Úloha byla restartována s výslovně vyjmenovanými cestami ještě před prvním pushem.
findings.detail_en: The restarted task declared its scope as ".", which Majordomus does not read as the whole repository, so majordomus check reported every changed file as out of scope. The task was restarted with explicit top-level paths before the first push.
findings.title_en: A scope of "." was caught before the first push

findings.detail_cs: Když se zadání rozrostlo o workspace v Rustu, datové soubory a nástroje pro Python, handover zaznamenal, že nové cesty nejvyšší úrovně leží mimo rozsah úlohy. Úloha skončila jako partial a nová si nárokovala 31 cest.
findings.detail_en: When the brief grew to a Rust workspace, data files and Python tooling, the handover recorded that the new top-level paths fell outside the task's scope. The task was finished as partial and a new one claimed 31 paths.
findings.title_cs: Zadání přerostlo nárokovaný rozsah; nová úloha si ho nárokovala
findings.title_en: The brief outgrew the claimed scope; a new task claimed it

findings.detail_cs: Checkpoint zapsaný po prvním pushi zaznamenává, že push využil výjimku pro administrátora v pravidlech repozitáře, která vyžadují CI. Nasazení přesto zůstalo podmíněné: ve workflow Pages job deploy závisí na jobech CI a job release na ověření produkce.
findings.detail_en: The checkpoint written after the first push records that the push used the admin bypass of the repository ruleset that requires CI. Deployment was still gated: in the Pages workflow the deploy job needs the CI jobs, and the release job needs production verification.
findings.title_cs: První push do main prošel přes výjimku pravidel pro administrátora
findings.title_en: The first push to main went through the ruleset's admin bypass

findings.detail_cs: Obě úlohy uzavřené jako dokončené spustily jako ověřovací příkaz smoke test proti živé URL (exit 0, 7 s). Úlohy uzavřené jako partial (3) žádný ověřovací příkaz nezaznamenaly a dokončení netvrdily.
findings.detail_en: Both tasks closed as completed ran the production smoke test against the live URL as their verification command (exit 0, 7 s). The 3 tasks closed as partial recorded no verification command and claimed no completion.
findings.title_cs: „Dokončeno“ se zaznamenalo jen s úspěšnou kontrolou živého webu
findings.title_en: "Completed" was recorded only with a passing check of the live site

findings.title_en: A Crossref title mismatch stopped a deployment

findings.detail_cs: Agent zaznamenal rozhodnutí o ledgeru důkazů jako navržené ADR a sám ho nepřijal. Poslední handover uvádí jeho přijetí nebo úpravu jako další krok pro člověka.
findings.detail_en: The agent recorded the evidence-ledger decision as a proposed ADR and did not accept it. The final handover lists accepting or amending it as the next action for a person.
findings.title_cs: ADR-0001 zůstalo návrhem; přijetí zůstalo na člověku
findings.title_en: ADR-0001 stayed proposed; acceptance was left to a person

findings.detail_en: Run 34860959250 failed in Verify production; Release was skipped. The next green run was 34863500153 for commit 2125f1e (feat(research): expand measuring-emotion with verified sources), which published v0.6.0.
